lines.speaker: bar_engineer
lines.text: They've sent a frame. For the halo. An actual enforcement frame, for a thing made of scrap that draws a picture on a ceiling.

lines.speaker: bar_engineer
lines.text: And it isn't about the halo. It's about whether a room full of engineers gets to build something nobody approved first. That's always been the whole question, and they've sent it round in a box with legs.

choices.text: It is a light on a ceiling.
